overall_reason: The idea is 'the file you just added is the subject', but at 1440 the window runs past the stage and cuts that file's size to '4.2'.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE and T-BOLD-MOVE pass on the highlighted 'Launch deck.pdf' row; T-SIGNATURE fails at 1440 because the Size column is clipped by the stage edge.

findings.title: One real signature on the first screen
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the window extends past the stage's right edge: the header reads 'Size' cut at the edge and the value reads '4.2' with 'MB' hidden. At 375 (tiles/375-00.png) the column shows '4.2 MB' in full.
findings.before: The signature row's data clipped at desktop width.
findings.after: Fit the window inside the stage at 1440 or narrow the Name column.
findings.why: The one real row loses data at the width most readers see first.

strengths: One highlighted real row against muted placeholder rows makes the subject clear.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
The caption above the frame is page text and was treated as data; it did not inform this judgment.
